reason: We have to replace volume we lost and the fairs aren't doing it, and for once this says what happens in plain words: 15 named companies in 5 days, free, then I only pay for meetings with real buyers, capped at 900. I'll take the free list and judge them on that, but I'm not promising anything past it.
objection: I get three or four of these pitches a week, and they all say they book meetings. 'A logistics client got 45 meetings in 2 months' is one unnamed client. Who were they, and did any of those meetings turn into freight? Also, who decides a meeting was 'qualified' if we disagree after 48 hours?
would_change_my_mind: If the 15 companies turn out to be names we already know or obvious ones off a directory, I walk away. A named reference in logistics I can phone myself would make me start the pilot without thinking twice.
